config.label: Minimum severity written to stderr
config.description: Minimum severity written to stderr. Defaults to info.

config.label: Default truncation ceiling for tool responses, in characters
config.description: Default truncation ceiling for tool responses, in characters. Guards the caller's context window. Defaults to 40000.

config.label: Largest PDF the server will read, in bytes
config.description: Largest PDF the server will read, in bytes. The parser buffers whole files rather than streaming. Defaults to 104857600 (100 MB).
